testing_and_data_attributes.rule: Every interactive, status, and navigation element MUST contain a kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a cohesive, single-page or tabbed React SOC Security Dashboard application.
Ensure the electric cyan accent (#00F0FF) is used intentionally for focal highlights, active states, and graph edges without overwhelming dark background surfaces.

Implement the live streaming terminal scan (~7 seconds simulated SSE stream) with crisp console typography, live timestamping, step status indicators, and automatic transition to findings/attack graph upon scan completion.
Make the 'Show Me the Attack' graph the visual hero centerpiece with interactive node selection, glowing connection edges, and a side detail panel that slides out on node click.
Ensure all 3 preloaded target environments display the required 'SYNTHETIC ENVIRONMENT' badge prominently.
Ensure all buttons, interactive nodes, tabs, code blocks, and filters include explicit data-testid attributes for automated testing.
